segments.text: This is why the practicing mind does not panic when mistakes happen. It observes. It corrects.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz waɪ ðə ˈpræktəsɪŋ maɪnd dʌz nɑt ˈpænɪk wɛn mɪˈsteɪks ˈhæpən ɪt əbˈzɝvz ɪt kərˈɛkts/

segments.text: And it tries again.
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪt traɪz əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: Observation is calm.
segments.ipa: /ˌɑbzərˈveɪʃən ɪz kɑm/

segments.text: Panic is noisy.
segments.ipa: /ˈpænɪk ɪz ˈnɔɪzi/

segments.text: A calm learner says, "I made a mistake. Good.
segments.ipa: /ə kɑm ˈlɝnər sɛz aɪ meɪd ə mɪˈsteɪk ɡʊd/

segments.text: Now I know what to practice."
segments.ipa: /naʊ aɪ noʊ wʌt tu ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: A noisy mind says, "I am terrible.
segments.ipa: /ə ˈnɔɪzi maɪnd sɛz aɪ æm ˈtɛrəbəl/

segments.text: I will never improve."
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɪl ˈnɛvər ˌɪmˈpruv/

segments.text: Which one do you think helps more?
segments.ipa: /wɪtʃ wʌn du ju θɪŋk hɛlps mɔr/

segments.text: Of course, the calm mind.
segments.ipa: /ʌv kɔrs ðə kɑm maɪnd/

segments.text: Patience is also very important.
segments.ipa: /ˈpeɪʃəns ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ˈvɛri ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt/

segments.text: Patience means you allow growth to take time.
segments.ipa: /ˈpeɪʃəns minz ju əˈlaʊ ɡroʊθ tu teɪk taɪm/

segments.text: You do not demand instant results.
segments.ipa: /ju du nɑt dɪˈmænd ˈɪnstənt rɪˈzʌlts/

segments.text: You understand that skill is built through repetition.
segments.ipa: /ju ˌʌndərˈstænd ðæt skɪl ɪz bɪlt θru ˌrɛpəˈtɪʃən/

segments.text: Many learners are impatient because they compare themselves with others.
segments.ipa: /ˈmɛni ˈlɝnərz ɑr ˌɪmˈpeɪʃənt bɪˈkɔz ðeɪ kəmˈpɛr ðɛmˈsɛlvz wɪð ˈʌðərz/

segments.text: They see someone speaking well and think, "Why not me?"
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ si ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈspikɪŋ wɛl ənd θɪŋk waɪ nɑt mi/

segments.text: But they do not see that person's full journey.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðeɪ du nɑt si ðæt ˈpɝsənz fʊl ˈdʒɝni/

segments.text: They do not see the years of practice.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ du nɑt si ðə jɪrz ʌv ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: They do not see the mistakes.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ du nɑt si ðə mɪˈsteɪks/

segments.text: They do not see the silent work.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ du nɑt si ðə ˈsaɪlənt wɝk/

segments.text: Comparison can steal your peace.
segments.ipa: /kəmˈpɛrəsən kæn stil jɔr pis/

segments.text: Your path is your path.
segments.ipa: /jɔr pæθ ɪz jɔr pæθ/

segments.text: Your practice is your practice.
segments.ipa: /jɔr ˈpræktəs ɪz jɔr ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: Your progress is your progress.
segments.ipa: /jɔr ˈprɑˌɡrɛs ɪz jɔr ˈprɑˌɡrɛs/

segments.text: This does not mean you cannot learn from others.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs dʌz nɑt min ju ˈkænɑt lɝn frʌm ˈʌðərz/

segments.text: Of course, you can.
segments.ipa: /ʌv kɔrs ju kæn/

segments.text: Good speakers can inspire you.
segments.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈspikərz kæn ˌɪnˈspaɪr ju/

segments.text: Teachers can guide you.
segments.ipa: /ˈtitʃərz kæn ɡaɪd ju/

segments.text: Advanced learners can show you what is possible.
segments.ipa: /ədˈvænst ˈlɝnərz kæn ʃoʊ ju wʌt ɪz ˈpɑsəbəl/

segments.text: But do not use other people as a weapon against yourself.
segments.ipa: /bʌt du nɑt jus ˈʌðər ˈpipəl æz ə ˈwɛpən əˈɡɛnst jərˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Use them as inspiration, not punishment.
segments.ipa: /jus ðɛm æz ˌɪnspərˈeɪʃən nɑt ˈpʌnɪʃmənt/

segments.text: The practicing mind stays with its own step.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈpræktəsɪŋ maɪnd steɪz wɪð ɪts oʊn stɛp/

segments.text: One step at a time.
segments.ipa: /wʌn stɛp æt ə taɪm/

segments.text: One sentence at a time.
segments.ipa: /wʌn ˈsɛntəns æt ə taɪm/

segments.text: One practice session at a time. Okay.
segments.ipa: /wʌn ˈpræktəs ˈsɛʃən æt ə taɪm ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Now let's bring everything together.
segments.ipa: /naʊ lɛts brɪŋ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ təˈɡɛðər/

segments.text: The practicing mind by Thomas Sterner is a book about learning how to practice with focus,
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈpræktəsɪŋ maɪnd baɪ ˈtɑməs ˈstɝnər ɪz ə bʊk əˈbaʊt ˈlɝnɪŋ haʊ tu ˈpræktəs wɪð ˈfoʊkəs/

segments.text: patience, and peace.
segments.ipa: /ˈpeɪʃəns ənd pis/

segments.text: It teaches us that real growth comes when we stop fighting the process and start living inside it.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈtitʃəz ʌs ðæt ril ɡroʊθ kʌmz wɛn wi stɑp ˈfaɪtɪŋ ðə ˈprɑˌsɛs ənd stɑrt ˈlɪvɪŋ ˌɪnˈsaɪd ɪt/

segments.text: This message is very important for English learners.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˈmɛsədʒ ɪz ˈvɛri ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt fɔr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɝnərz/

segments.text: Many learners want fluent English, but they do not enjoy practice.
segments.ipa: /ˈmɛni ˈlɝnərz wɑnt ˈfluənt ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ bʌt ðeɪ du nɑt ˌɛnˈdʒɔɪ ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: They want the final result, but they feel frustrated by the daily steps.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ wɑnt ðə ˈfaɪnəl rɪˈzʌlt bʌt ðeɪ fil ˈfrʌˌstreɪtəd baɪ ðə ˈdeɪli stɛps/

segments.text: They want to speak naturally, but they feel ashamed of mistakes.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ wɑnt tu spik ˈnætʃərəli bʌt ðeɪ fil əˈʃeɪmd ʌv mɪˈsteɪks/

segments.text: They want to understand fast English, but they get angry when they miss words.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ wɑnt tu ˌʌndərˈstænd fæst ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ bʌt ðeɪ ɡɛt ˈæŋɡri wɛn ðeɪ mɪs wɝdz/

segments.text: This book gives us a better way.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs bʊk ɡɪvz ʌs ə ˈbɛtər weɪ/

segments.text: The first lesson is to focus on the process, not only on the result.
segments.ipa: /ðə fɝst ˈlɛsən ɪz tu ˈfoʊkəs ɑn ðə ˈprɑˌsɛs nɑt ˈoʊnli ɑn ðə rɪˈzʌlt/

segments.text: The result is fluency.
segments.ipa: /ðə rɪˈzʌlt ɪz ˈfluənsi/

segments.text: The process is listening today, repeating today, speaking today, reviewing today.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈprɑˌsɛs ɪz ˈlɪsənɪŋ təˈdeɪ rɪˈpitɪŋ təˈdeɪ ˈspikɪŋ təˈdeɪ rivˈjuɪŋ təˈdeɪ/

segments.text: You cannot control the exact day when fluency will arrive, but you can control today's practice.
segments.ipa: /ju ˈkænɑt kənˈtroʊl ðə ɪɡˈzækt deɪ wɛn ˈfluənsi wɪl ərˈaɪv bʌt ju kæn kənˈtroʊl təˈdeɪz ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: So, come back to the process.
segments.ipa: /soʊ kʌm bæk tu ðə ˈprɑˌsɛs/

segments.text: The second lesson is to be present.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈlɛsən ɪz tu bi ˈprɛzənt/

segments.text: Practice happens now, not yesterday, not tomorrow. Now.
segments.ipa: /ˈpræktəs ˈhæpənz naʊ nɑt ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ nɑt təˈmɑˌroʊ naʊ/

segments.text: If you are listening, listen.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju ɑr ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈlɪsən/

segments.text: If you're repeating, repeat.
segments.ipa: /ɪf jʊr rɪˈpitɪŋ rɪˈpit/

segments.text: If you're speaking, speak.
segments.ipa: /ɪf jʊr ˈspikɪŋ spik/

segments.text: Do not judge your whole future while practicing one sentence.
segments.ipa: /du nɑt dʒʌdʒ jɔr hoʊl ˈfjutʃər waɪl ˈpræktəsɪŋ wʌn ˈsɛntəns/

segments.text: One sentence deserves your attention.
segments.ipa: /wʌn ˈsɛntəns dɪˈzɝvz jɔr əˈtɛnʃən/

segments.text: The third lesson is calm discipline.
segments.ipa: /ðə θɝd ˈlɛsən ɪz kɑm ˈdɪsəplən/

segments.text: Discipline does not need to be harsh.
segments.ipa: /ˈdɪsəplən dʌz nɑt nid tu bi hɑrʃ/

segments.text: You do not need to insult yourself to improve.
segments.ipa: /ju du nɑt nid tu ˌɪnˈsʌlt jərˈsɛlf tu ˌɪmˈpruv/

segments.text: You do not need shame.
segments.ipa: /ju du nɑt nid ʃeɪm/

segments.text: You need a small plan, a steady routine, and the ability to return.
segments.ipa: /ju nid ə smɔl plæn ə ˈstɛdi ruˈtin ənd ðə əˈbɪləˌti tu rɪˈtɝn/

segments.text: Gentle discipline lasts longer than angry discipline.
segments.ipa: /ˈdʒɛntəl ˈdɪsəplən læsts ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ˈæŋɡri ˈdɪsəplən/

segments.text: The fourth lesson is slow down.
segments.ipa: /ðə fɔrθ ˈlɛsən ɪz sloʊ daʊn/

segments.text: Slow practice is not weak.
segments.ipa: /sloʊ ˈpræktəs ɪz nɑt wik/

segments.text: If you want to speak faster later, practice clearly now.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju wɑnt tu spik ˈfæstər ˈleɪtər ˈpræktəs ˈklɪrli naʊ/

segments.text: The next lesson is to see mistakes as information.
segments.ipa: /ðə nɛkst ˈlɛsən ɪz tu si mɪˈsteɪks æz ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən/

segments.text: And the next lesson is patience.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə nɛkst ˈlɛsən ɪz ˈpeɪʃəns/

segments.text: English takes time.
segments.ipa: /ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ teɪks taɪm/

segments.text: Any real skill takes time.
segments.ipa: /ˈɛni ril skɪl teɪks taɪm/

segments.text: You cannot force growth, but you can support it.
segments.ipa: /ju ˈkænɑt fɔrs ɡroʊθ bʌt ju kæn səˈpɔrt ɪt/

segments.text: You can show up.
segments.ipa: /ju kæn ʃoʊ ʌp/

segments.text: You can repeat.
segments.ipa: /ju kæn rɪˈpit/

segments.text: You can practice.
segments.ipa: /ju kæn ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: You can continue.
segments.ipa: /ju kæn kənˈtɪnju/

segments.text: So now let's make this practical.
segments.ipa: /soʊ naʊ lɛts meɪk ðɪs ˈpræktəkəl/

segments.text: How can you use the practicing mind for English every day?
segments.ipa: /haʊ kæn ju jus ðə ˈpræktəsɪŋ maɪnd fɔr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈɛvəri deɪ/

segments.text: Start with a small practice session.
segments.ipa: /stɑrt wɪð ə smɔl ˈpræktəs ˈsɛʃən/

segments.text: Maybe 10 minutes.
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪbi ˈmɪnəts/

segments.text: Maybe 5 minutes.
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪbi ˈmɪnəts/

segments.text: Maybe even 2 minutes on a very busy day.
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪbi ˈivɪn ˈmɪnəts ɑn ə ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi deɪ/

segments.text: Make the practice simple enough to repeat.
segments.ipa: /meɪk ðə ˈpræktəs ˈsɪmpəl ɪˈnʌf tu rɪˈpit/

segments.text: Choose one short audio.
segments.ipa: /tʃuz wʌn ʃɔrt ˈɑdiˌoʊ/

segments.text: Listen to it without pressure.
segments.ipa: /ˈlɪsən tu ɪt wɪˈθaʊt ˈprɛʃər/

segments.text: Try to understand the main idea. Listen again.
segments.ipa: /traɪ tu ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə meɪn aɪˈdiə ˈlɪsən əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: Notice useful phrases.
segments.ipa: /ˈnoʊtəs ˈjusfəl ˈfreɪzəz/

segments.text: Then choose one sentence.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn tʃuz wʌn ˈsɛntəns/

segments.text: Repeat it slowly.
segments.ipa: /rɪˈpit ɪt ˈsloʊli/

segments.text: Feel the rhythm.
segments.ipa: /fil ðə ˈrɪðəm/

segments.text: Copy the pronunciation.
segments.ipa: /ˈkɑpi ðə proʊˌnʌnsiˈeɪʃən/

segments.text: Then use the sentence in your own way.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn jus ðə ˈsɛntəns ɪn jɔr oʊn weɪ/

segments.text: Change one word.
segments.ipa: /tʃeɪndʒ wʌn wɝd/

segments.text: Make it personal.
segments.ipa: /meɪk ɪt ˈpɝsɪnəl/

segments.text: Make it about yourself.
segments.ipa: /meɪk ɪt əˈbaʊt jərˈsɛlf/

segments.text: And then speak for 1 minute.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛn spik fɔr ˈmɪnət/

segments.text: Talk about your day.
segments.ipa: /tɔk əˈbaʊt jɔr deɪ/

segments.text: Talk about your learning.
segments.ipa: /tɔk əˈbaʊt jɔr ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: And talk about your goal.
segments.ipa: /ənd tɔk əˈbaʊt jɔr ɡoʊl/

segments.text: This is a simple process.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz ə ˈsɪmpəl ˈprɑˌsɛs/

segments.text: Listening, noticing, repeating, changing, and speaking.
segments.ipa: /ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈnoʊtɪsɪŋ rɪˈpitɪŋ ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ ənd ˈspikɪŋ/

segments.text: Do it calmly.
segments.ipa: /du ɪt ˈkɑmli/

segments.text: Do it patiently.
segments.ipa: /du ɪt ˈpeɪʃəntli/

segments.text: Do it without attacking yourself.
segments.ipa: /du ɪt wɪˈθaʊt əˈtækɪŋ jərˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Do it with attention.
segments.ipa: /du ɪt wɪð əˈtɛnʃən/

segments.text: Do it again tomorrow.
segments.ipa: /du ɪt əˈɡɛn təˈmɑˌroʊ/

segments.text: This is the real power.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz ðə ril ˈpaʊər/

segments.text: If you feel tired, say, "I can do the small version today."
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju fil ˈtaɪərd seɪ aɪ kæn du ðə smɔl ˈvɝʒən təˈdeɪ/

segments.text: If you miss one day, say, "I'm back." All right.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju mɪs wʌn deɪ seɪ aɪm bæk ɔl raɪt/

segments.text: Thank you so much again for listening to English Unleashed.
segments.ipa: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ əˈɡɛn fɔr ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ənˈliʃt/

segments.text: I hope this episode helped you understand the main ideas of the book, The Practicing Mind,
segments.ipa: /aɪ hoʊp ðɪs ˈɛpəˌsoʊd hɛlpt ju ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə meɪn aɪˈdiəz ʌv ðə bʊk ðə ˈpræktəsɪŋ maɪnd/

segments.text: in easy English.
segments.ipa: /ɪn ˈizi ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

segments.text: Listen again if you can.
segments.ipa: /ˈlɪsən əˈɡɛn ɪf ju kæn/

segments.text: The first time, understand the message.
segments.ipa: /ðə fɝst taɪm ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə ˈmɛsədʒ/

segments.text: The second time, notice useful vocabulary.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈsɛkənd taɪm ˈnoʊtəs ˈjusfəl voʊˈkæbjəˌlɛri/

segments.text: The third time, shadow the sentences and practice speaking.
segments.ipa: /ðə θɝd taɪm ˈʃæˌdoʊ ðə ˈsɛntənsəz ənd ˈpræktəs ˈspikɪŋ/

segments.text: Bye for now.
segments.ipa: /baɪ fɔr naʊ/
